saints.name: Sts. Joachim and Anne
saints.title: Parents of the Blessed Virgin Mary
saints.shortBlurb: The parents of Our Lady and grandparents of the Lord, honored by ancient tradition though unnamed in Scripture…
biography: The names of Mary's parents are not given in the Gospels but come down through early tradition, above all the Protoevangelium of James: Joachim and Anne, a devout couple who in their old age were granted the child who would become the Mother of God.
Devotion to St. Anne especially spread widely in the Middle Ages; she is invoked by mothers and by those who long for children.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 26 July
